summary: Speed indicator for unknown-total progress tasks is implemented in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gains show_speed (default off) and a classmethod render_speed; module-level track() gains show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables and leaves total None. CHANGELOG entry added under Unreleased/Added. In tests/test_progress.py, added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the two ValueError assertions. Nothing was run or committed, so all changes are verified by reading only.
